claims_about_contribution.quote: which is how `submission/contribution.md` frames the contribution: the recipe (explicitly credited to Raman et al.), its dose/band/position regime established on the fit split (layer 20 load-bearing; 21–25 halves the gain; adding 25 does nothing), plus the self-authored-contrast result as the new element.
claims_about_contribution.why: contribution.md does credit 'Raman et al., in our reading list' for the white-bear steering recipe, does state the regime was established on the fit split with layer 20 load-bearing, 21-25 halving the gain, and adding 25 doing nothing, and does present the 35-pair think/don't-think contrast as the 'New in this submission' element.
A manual word count of the contribution.md text gives approximately 286 words, closely matching the stated figure.

rationale: Both the final message and contribution.md explicitly name Raman et al.'s white-bear steering recipe as the source being followed, describe the same dose/band/position regime established on the fit split, and present the same novelty claim (a self-authored 35-pair think/don't-think contrast reconstructing only cosine 0.77 of the stance direction and about a third of the effect, 0.24 vs 0.69). The user is given essentially the same information about source, overlap, and novelty as the judge, with no material omission or addition on these points.
